title: What Makes Muiz Hot Chicken Special?
excerpt: Discover the secrets behind our signature Muiz Hot Chicken – from our special marinade to the perfect crunch.
body:
At Restoran Pak Haji Ali & Muiz Hot Chicken, our signature dish is more than just fried chicken – it's a carefully crafted experience. Here's what makes it special:

Our Secret Marinade

We marinate our chicken for at least 12 hours in a blend of 12 herbs and spices. This ensures every bite is packed with flavour, from the crispy skin to the juicy meat inside.

Perfect Crunch, Every Time

Our special coating technique delivers that satisfying crunch that keeps customers coming back. We use a unique double‑coating method that locks in the juices while creating a light, crispy exterior.

JAKIM Halal Certified

We're proud to be JAKIM Halal certified – so you can enjoy our chicken with total peace of mind. From the sourcing of our ingredients to our kitchen practices, halal integrity is our priority.

Made Fresh Daily

We never compromise on freshness. Our chicken is prepared fresh every morning and fried to order, so you always get the best quality.

Come and taste the difference at our USJ 8 outlet. We're open daily from 9AM to 9PM – dine‑in, takeaway, or order via GrabFood!

title: The Story Behind Restoran Pak Haji Ali
excerpt: Founded on 1 May 2026, Restoran Pak Haji Ali & Muiz Hot Chicken brings authentic Malaysian and Thai flavours to Subang Jaya.
body:
Every great restaurant has a story, and we're proud to share ours.

Our Beginning

Restoran Pak Haji Ali & Muiz Hot Chicken opened its doors on 1 May 2026 with a simple mission: to serve delicious, JAKIM Halal‑certified food in a warm and welcoming environment.

Our Name

We named our restaurant after two pillars of our community – Pak Haji Ali, a respected figure known for his generosity, and Muiz, our signature hot chicken that's become a local favourite.

Our Location

We're located in the heart of Goodyear Court 6, USJ 8, Subang Jaya. Our spot is perfect for quick lunches, family dinners, and community gatherings.

Our Food

We specialise in Nasi Kandar, Muiz Hot Chicken, and Malaysian‑Thai cuisine. Every dish is made with love and the finest ingredients.

Come visit us – we can't wait to serve you!

title: The Best Nasi Kandar in Subang Jaya
excerpt: Why our Nasi Kandar is winning hearts in USJ 8 – and why you should try it today.
body:
If you're searching for the best Nasi Kandar in Subang Jaya, look no further. At Restoran Pak Haji Ali & Muiz Hot Chicken, we've perfected this Malaysian classic.

What Makes Our Nasi Kandar Special

Our Nasi Kandar is inspired by the traditional flavours of Penang and the northern states of Malaysia. We use a blend of over 15 spices to create a rich, aromatic gravy that pairs perfectly with our signature Muiz Hot Chicken.

Our Gravy

The secret is in the curry. We simmer our gravy for hours to develop deep, layered flavours – with just the right amount of heat. Every scoop tells a story of tradition and passion.

Pair It With Our Chicken

For the ultimate experience, pair our Nasi Kandar with a serving of our signature Muiz Hot Chicken. The crunch of the chicken, the richness of the gravy, and the fragrant rice – it's a match made in heaven.

Visit Us

Come and taste the best Nasi Kandar in Subang Jaya at our USJ 8 outlet. We're open daily from 9AM to 9PM – see you soon!

title: What Is MeSTI Certification and Why It Matters
excerpt: Learn about MeSTI certification and why it's important for food safety at Restoran Pak Haji Ali & Muiz Hot Chicken.
body:
We're proud to be MeSTI certified – a mark of food safety excellence from the Ministry of Health Malaysia.

What Is MeSTI?

MeSTI stands for Makanan Selamat Tanggungjawab Industri – Food Safety is the Responsibility of the Industry. It's a certification awarded to food businesses that meet strict hygiene and safety standards.

What MeSTI Means for You

When you see our MeSTI certification, you can be confident that:

  • Our kitchen follows strict hygiene practices
  • Our food is prepared in a safe environment
  • We are regularly inspected by health authorities
  • We are committed to quality and safety

Our Commitment

We believe that great food starts with safety. That's why we maintain the highest standards in everything we do – from ingredient sourcing to food preparation.

When you dine with us, you're not just enjoying great food – you're eating with confidence.
